title: Samson studio Liquid Swords goes bankrupt ⚖️
subject: samson
description:
What should happen to Samson now? 👇

Swedish studio Liquid Swords, the developer and publisher of Samson: A Tyndalston Story, was declared bankrupt by the Stockholm District Court on October 12, 2026. Founded by Just Cause creator Christofer Sundberg, the studio employed close to 30 people. The administrator is selling the company and its assets, with bids closing October 21.

Sources: Breakit (Oct 15, 2026), Kotaku (Oct 17, 2026), Insider Gaming (Oct 16, 2026), Gametalk

scenes.text: Liquid Swords, the studio behind Samson, is bankrupt.
Stockholm District Court issued the order on October 12, Swedish outlet Breakit reports.
Christofer Sundberg, who led the Just Cause games at Avalanche, founded the studio in 2020.
Samson hit Steam on April 8 and PS5 and Xbox on September 21. Bugs kept it at 51 on Metacritic.
